source_refs.note: Exercise 13.3, Question 6 (a)-(c): velocity, acceleration and time of maximum velocity for x(t) = 30t^2 - 4t^3 (book p.258). Answer key (PDF 311) prints it as number 12.

blocks.prompt: 6 (a) The position of a car traveling along a straight highway is given by \(x(t) = 30t^2 - 4t^3\), where \(x(t)\) is the distance traveled in kilometers and \(t\) is the time in hours. Find the car's velocity at \(t = 3\) hours.
blocks.explanation:
Velocity position ka derivative hai.
Humein \(v(3)\) find karni hai.
Car ki misaal: speedometer har lamhe jo number dikhata hai woh yahi instantaneous velocity hai.
Plan: \(x(t)\) ko differentiate kar ke \(t = 3\) rakhna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(x(t) = 30t^2 - 4t^3\) (kilometers aur hours).
Humein find karna hai: \(v(3)\).
Tareeqa: \(v(t) = x'(t)\). Yahan position ka naam \(x\) hai aur variable \(t\); ghabraiye nahi, hum \(t\) ke lehaz se differentiate kar rahe hain.

Differentiate karein
\[v(t) = 60t - 12t^2\]
Kyun: \(30t^2 \to 60t\) aur \(4t^3 \to 12t^2\), power rule se.

\(t = 3\) rakhein
\[v(3) = 180 - 108 = 72\]
Kyun: \(60 \times 3 = 180\), \(12 \times 9 = 108\). Unit km/h, kyunke faasla km mein aur waqt hours mein hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\frac{x(3.001) - x(2.999)}{0.002} \approx 72.0\]
Kyun: Chhote waqfe ki average velocity bhi 72 aayi.

blocks.prompt: 6 (b) The position of a car traveling along a straight highway is given by \(x(t) = 30t^2 - 4t^3\), where \(x(t)\) is the distance traveled in kilometers and \(t\) is the time in hours. Determine the car's acceleration at \(t = 3\) hours.
blocks.explanation:
Acceleration velocity ka derivative hai.
Humein \(a(3)\) find karni hai.
Plan: \(v(t)\) ko differentiate kar ke \(t = 3\) rakhna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(v(t) = 60t - 12t^2\) (part (a) se).
Humein find karna hai: \(a(3)\).
Tareeqa: \(a(t) = v'(t)\).

Velocity ko differentiate karein
\[a(t) = 60 - 24t\]
Kyun: \(60t \to 60\) aur \(12t^2 \to 24t\).

\(t = 3\) rakhein
\[a(3) = 60 - 72 = -12\]
Kyun: Negative acceleration ka matlab hai ke car 3 ghante par ahista ho rahi hai (brake jaisi halat), halaanke abhi bhi aage chal rahi hai (velocity 72 positive hai).
Dhyan dein: Negative acceleration ka matlab peeche chalna nahi; sirf raftaar kam ho rahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 6 (c) The position of a car traveling along a straight highway is given by \(x(t) = 30t^2 - 4t^3\), where \(x(t)\) is the distance traveled in kilometers and \(t\) is the time in hours. After how many hours does the car reach its maximum velocity?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh velocity ke maximum ka sawal hai.
Humein woh waqt chahiye jab \(v(t)\) sab se zyada ho.
Plan: \(v'(t) = a(t) = 0\) rakhna aur \(a(t)\) ka sign check karna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(v(t) = 60t - 12t^2\), \(a(t) = 60 - 24t\).
Humein find karna hai: maximum velocity ka waqt.
Tareeqa: Velocity apni choti par na barh rahi hoti hai na ghat rahi, yani us ka rate of change (acceleration) zero hota hai.

\(a(t) = 0\) hal karein
\[60 - 24t = 0\]
\[t = \dfrac{60}{24} = 2.5\]
Kyun: Velocity graph ki choti par slope zero hai, aur velocity ka slope hi acceleration hai.

Maximum ki tasdeeq
\[t < 2.5:\ a(t) > 0\]
\[t > 2.5:\ a(t) < 0\]
Kyun: 2.5 ghante se pehle acceleration positive (car tez ho rahi hai), baad mein negative (car ahista ho rahi hai). Is liye 2.5 ghante par raftaar sab se zyada hai.

Maximum velocity
\[v(2.5) = 150 - 75 = 75\ \text{km/h}\]
Kyun: \(60 \times 2.5 = 150\), \(12 \times 6.25 = 75\). Yeh \(v(3) = 72\) se zyada hai, jo part (b) ke negative acceleration se mel khata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key ne Exercise 13.3 ke jawabat ko 1 se 8 ke bajaye 4, 5, 6, 8, 11, 12, 13, 14 number diye hain. Is sawal ka jawab number 12 par chhapa hai: (a) 72 km/h, (b) \(-12\) km/h\(^2\), (c) 2.5 hrs, sab sahi.
